The whole outside of the house

The roof is only part of it. Gutters carry the water away from the house, and siding keeps it out of the walls. Serafim does those too.

See what Serafim does

What Serafim does

Ask about a job
  1. 01Roof replacementA whole new roof when the old one is past saving. Soft or rotten decking usually gets replaced before the new roof goes on.→
  2. 02Roof repairs and leaksThe job is finding where the water really gets in. Often that is a lifted shingle or worn flashing around a chimney or vent.→
  3. 03Storm damage repairsShingles torn off by wind, or a hole where a limb came down. The aim is a sound roof that sheds water again.→
  4. 04GuttersNew gutters and downspouts put up, or sagging ones set straight. That way rain runs off the roof and away from the house.→
  5. 05SidingCracked or worn siding replaced, so the walls keep the weather out the way the roof does.→

My roof is leaking right now. What do I do?

Call Serafim and say where the water is showing up. Until it's fixed, put a bucket under the drip. Move anything that could get wet.

Answers before you call

Do I need a new roof, or will a repair do?

Serafim looks at the roof and tells you which one he thinks it needs. Loose shingles or bad flashing can often be fixed on their own. When the whole roof is worn out, he'll say so.

Can you fix storm damage?

Yes. Wind and falling limbs do most of it. Usually the first job is closing the roof up so no more rain gets in, and the repairs come after that.

Do you do gutters and siding as well?

Yes. Gutters and siding go along with the roof, so the outside of the house can be one job with one person to call.

What area do you work in?

Call with your address and you'll find out if your street is in his area.

Who will I be talking to?

Serafim. The number on this page is his own phone, so you talk the job over with him directly.
